title: Senufo people - Wikipedia
text: The Senufo people, also known as Siena, Senefo, Sene, Senoufo, and Syénambélé, are a West African ethnolinguistic group. They consist of diverse subgroups living in a region spanning northern Ivory Coast, southeastern Mali, and western Burkina Faso.
